verdict.rationale: Hoppscotch's own docs say collections can be used for collaboration with your team. The changelog references team workspaces ("Team search in workspace search and spotlight"), and the MCP docs expose teams alongside collections, so team sharing of collections is a first-party capability. However, no evidence describes how a shared workspace is created, how members are invited, or that collections stay synced across members. missing for 10: explicit documentation of shared team workspaces and invites, evidence of real-time or synced collection updates across members, and independent hands-on corroboration of team sharing.

support.subject: As a developer, I can share collections with my team in a synced shared workspace

citations.quote: You can organize your requests categorically for future reference or collaboration with your team using collections.
